description.zh: 控制 DSH 右栏内置 Browser 的 Agent 插件：快照编号 refs、点击/输入/按键/选择/滚动、截图，按问题检索阅读与变化对比（实测比整页快照省约 98% 字符），一次 batch 最多 12 步，多标签按会话隔离。
description.en: Agent control for the Browser panel DSH ships in the right Sidebar: numbered snapshot refs, click/type/press/select/scroll, screenshots, query-scoped reads and change diffs that measured ~98% fewer characters than a full snapshot, up to 12 steps per batch, and session-scoped multi-tab focus/close.
